approaches.name: Owner-run in-box Windows UI Automation read-only pilot
requirements: Same session/integrity and reviewed UIA/COM access
Known owned disposable Excel PID/start time/workbook/XLL
approaches.coverage: Actual initialized control AutomationId/name/enabled/offscreen/geometry after native release; no statistics or chart values from mere UI tree
approaches.risk: Provider hangs, UIPI/session/user mismatch, modal prompts, custom RefEdit inner textbox accessibility, changing focus/DPI and constructor side effects

Empty/unstable AutomationId: owner establishes actual mapping, no index click fallback
Unexpected dialog/extra workbook/process: fail and preserve evidence
RefEdit stale RCW: do not induce deletion in ordinary pilot
approaches.provider_limit: Modeless WinForms may be top-level owned windows. Proposed UIA enumerates only the verified process roots and reads Toggle/Selection/Value patterns; provider behavior is not executed/qualified.

No generic sheet deletion or 0x800401A8 induction without separate hazardous-simulation authority

claim_limit: No UIA provider or Excel UI interaction demonstrated; readable desktop and installed APIs are feasibility evidence only. Codex CLI itself is not a GUI driver. Mac availability irrelevant to Windows pilots; Office browser tests separate.
